DML.SELECT: SELECT route_id as "id", alias as "alias", description as "description", coordinates as "coordinates", auto_route as "autoRoute", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.routes WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.routes (route_id, alias, description, coordinates, auto_route, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.routes'$'route_id'}, :alias, :description, :coordinates, :autoRoute, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.routes SET alias = :alias, description = :description, coordinates = :coordinates, auto_route = :autoRoute, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE route_id = :id
